title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Goodwill for a Redeemed Note Past Its Expiry (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
**Goodwill rule.** On a refund of a Finch Note left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, a customer whose redeemed note had passed its expiry date by the request date and who holds an active Marlowe & Finch card receives the card lapsed-note goodwill of $10.00; one whose redeemed note had passed its expiry date and who holds no active Marlowe & Finch card receives the no-card lapsed-note goodwill of $5.00. A customer whose redeemed note had not passed its expiry date by the request date is outside this rule.

The expiry date is the one shown on the issue of that note in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program note ledger; the card holding is read from the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts.

## Both sides of the expiry date (hypothetical request date 20 June)

| Note expiry date | Active Marlowe & Finch card | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| 19 June | Yes | $10.00 |
| 19 June | No | $5.00 |
| 20 June | Yes or No | outside this rule — not yet passed on the request date |
| 30 June | Yes or No | outside this rule |
